Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced an unsupported assumption that there might be another “Bubblegum Alley” in San Diego’s Gaslamp Quarter and directed searches (even suggesting inferring coordinates) despite no evidence from the provided results. This caused scope creep and unnecessary looping instead of consolidating the already sufficient, authoritative evidence that Bubblegum Alley is in San Luis Obispo, California.
